name: Alchemist Divine Alchemist
body:
As a divine alchemist, you have the following class features.

Channel Energy (Su)

Your alchemist levels stack with your cleric levels for the purpose of the channel energy class feature. If you have no cleric levels, you gain the channel energy ability of a cleric equal to your alchemist level. This replaces bomb.

Spontaneous Spells

If you channel positive energy, you can spontaneously cast a cure spell by expending one of your prepared extracts of the same level or lower. If you channel negative energy, you can spontaneously cast an inflict spell by expending one of your prepared extracts of the same level or lower. Your caster level for these spells equals your alchemist level plus your cleric level (if any). The save DC of these spells is equal to 10 + the spell level + your Wisdom modifier.
